chronology: Design fixed before any R19 economic outcome. Implementation and validation hashes must also be frozen before execution. Preflight algebra and arithmetic tests are not economic evidence.
primary_target: Mean regret over the declared finite task population, relative to every common scalar withdrawal rate in each task interval, followed by the fixed future policy.
model_relation: Same tanh-coupled capital recursion, current logarithmic consumption payoff, and terminal dispersion penalty as R16. This additional finite-support stress economy does not replace the inherited Gaussian experiments or claim Gaussian/diffusion accuracy.

scenario_law.generation: Eight standard-normal arrays, clipped to [-3,3], and their antithetic negatives. Each stored array has probability 1/16. Arrays are generated once per dimension and hashed before fitting; the finite support, not a Gaussian approximation claim, defines the model.

tasks.population: One fixed 1024-query catalogue per dimension; six nested prefixes. Task and state generators are independent of fitting and cache draws. The charge is a current-date resource cost, not a change to future preferences.

method_details.NBO: Scalar tanh network of widths 32,32 with known terminal-dispersion baseline; fit common value and costate labels.
method_details.quadratic: Ridge-regularized conventional postdecision regression on constant, coordinate, coordinate-square, and squared-mean features, using the same value and derivative labels.
method_details.rbf: Ridge-regularized Gaussian radial-basis scalar continuation, 32 fixed training centers plus constant and coordinate features, using the same value and derivative labels.
method_details.shared_actor: One task-conditioned scalar actor fitted by direct differentiation through the same cached future scenarios; no access to audit output during fitting.
method_details.SAA: Legal common-scenario caching, four then sixteen sampled scenarios with replacement; the entire state recursion is reevaluated at every new action.
method_details.enumerated: Full sixteen-scenario scalar optimization, using 28 bisection iterations, as a structure-exploiting classical comparator.
method_details.myopic: Exact maximization of the known current reward, omitting the future continuation, as a no-learning control.

stopping: Each complete procedure stops at its first declared stage whose mean scalar-regret upper bound is <= tolerance. Otherwise it returns unresolved after the last stage. Myopic and enumerated have one stage. No missing or failed fit is silently dropped. A software failure is retained and may be corrected only with an explicit versioned amendment, never by changing seeds or budgets after outcome inspection.
certificate: A uniform strong-concavity lower bound and an outward-rounded full-support derivative enclosure at each actual selected action. At a constraint boundary use the one-sided KKT residual. Regret upper bound is residual squared divided by twice the curvature lower bound. Nonpositive curvature or infeasibility means no certificate. There is no Monte Carlo failure allocation for exact finite-support enumeration.
work: Measure independent complete per-method/per-stream/per-query-volume executions. Include model/task construction, legal cache construction, every fit, every failed stage check, action queries, certificate construction, and record serialization. Separately state shared library startup and the cost of post-stop mechanism reporting; neither is silently assigned an observed per-method clock. No inherited prefix time is called a prospective stop time.
mechanism: After policy freeze, evaluate absolute prediction risk on three exogenous scalar actions per query and on the method's own selected actions, using the exact finite-support mean. Regenerate fitting and Raw caches for all three complete streams. Report every method and stream; this finite-stream record is not a population confidence interval over arbitrary future fits. A separate two-independent-bank identity supplies an unbiased method-level audit design.
economic_reporting: Report current withdrawal charges, selected withdrawals, scalar-regret certificates, and the equivalent external log-utility grant exp(regret/A0)-1. Do not identify that grant with endogenous consumption rescaling or an estimated policy effect.
release_gate: All new theory, original inherited content, source and protocol identities, full run records, failures, and referee-response statuses must be retained. Native TeX build results may be claimed only after actual compilation.
